notes.title: New update to make the game available for NON VR players (Flatscreen)
notes.content:
Hey guys, I know we have been without new updates for quite some time, but this time our update is pretty simples.
We just made possible for non-vr players to play the game.
Nevertheless, comment on the forum if you guys have any suggestions.
Cheers,

notes.title: New update live - Motion Controls and Roomscale!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26552706/240fad8e673f1d3d6bbdbe6a8c5a11318b7ea441.png

The Rabbit Hole has a new update with tons of features, specially: Motion controls and roomscale.

- Motion Controls (HTC Vive and Oculus Rift): Both controllers now simulate hands to interact with game objects.
- Hardcore mode (Oculus Rift) that allow players to move around with the Touch Controller instead of teleport mechanics.
- Roomscale (HTC Vive) that allow players to walk freely within available area.
- New jump scares and game content.
- New, improved and interactive main menu.
- Several bug fixes.
